results.name: dataCollectionRule
results.reason: The exact REST 2024-03-11 ExtensionDataSource.extensionSettings schema contains a description only: no type, properties, or additionalProperties. Learn renders the field as any(...) and says its format is extension-specific. The current ContainerInsights dataCollectionSettings nested fields therefore lack a public exact wire schema; general Learn configuration guidance does not close that gap. Do not mark the pair assessed.
results.migration: Current and latest GA are both 2024-03-11; no newer GA candidate.

findings.detail: dataCollectionEndpointId is declared optional string with no nullable=true; the default enableContainerNetworkLogs=false branch supplies null. The schema does not prove that explicit null is accepted.
ContainerInsights extensionSettings contains nested dataCollectionSettings properties with no exact public API schema; see the pair blocker and preserve this as unverified.
